title: My Sister-In-Law Forged Our $640K Oxygen Deal, Left Me $4,200. So I Watched Her Lose It All
description: After 31 years in ICU, I poured $141,000 into a home oxygen and CPAP business with my sister-in-law. She forged a dissolution, sold our Medicare contracts for $640,000, and mailed me a $4,200 cannula check. I found the notarized 50/50 agreement inside a hollow concentrator, voided the sale, and now she sterilizes masks in a smock that says Cut Off My Air. #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #OxygenBusiness
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY $640K DEAL AND LOST EVERYTHING
pinned_comment: I want to know what you would do if your sister-in-law forged a dissolution, sold your $640,000 Medicare contracts, and mailed you a $4,200 cannula check. If something like this happened to you, or you found the one paper that saved everything, share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND THE ONLY NOTARIZED PARTNERSHIP HIDDEN IN A DUMPSTER OXYGEN CONCENTRATOR
